relations: Firework bursts illuminate the sky and cast brief shimmering reflections on the dark harbor water.
As the purple firework sparks fade, their trails dim and drift downward over the buildings.
Distant harbor lights persist as steady vertical reflections on the water surface.
Boat masts remain silhouetted against the night sky regardless of the firework flashes.
